title: Client Lifecycle Profile
description: Declarative join/leave (and eventually move) definition for a single client. One file per client. The runbook becomes data; the per-system logic lives in shared modules; the orchestrator selects the lane via -Action.

domains.description: All routable domains, e.g. uovo.com / uovo.fashion / uovo.art.

identity.description: Where the user truly lives. This one field drives most downstream behavior.

backbone.description: entra = cloud-only M365 is source of truth (Raith, BridgeInvest). google = Google Workspace primary, M365 mirrors it (Drive, Human Capital). ad-synced = on-prem AD syncs up to Entra via AD Connect (Six One, UOVO). ad-standalone = on-prem AD plus a SEPARATE, unsynced M365/Entra, both managed independently (Regal).

usernamePatterns.description: Ordered; each tried until a unique one is found. Tokens: {first} {last} {firstInitial} {domain}.

domainRules.description: Optional conditional domain/OU routing, e.g. uovo.fashion -> GardeRobe OU; Prialto users -> Prialto OU.

mode.description: generate = unique per user; shared-default = a standing 'Default New User Password' pulled from a secret (Human Capital, UOVO).

onOffboard.description: reset-and-capture = reset then deliver the new password to the manager/delegate via secure email.

when.description: always = every run; on-request = only if a case variable asks for it; never = system absent for this lifecycle action.

lane.description: Per-action behavior for one system. Omit the lane to mean 'never' for that action.

dependsOn.description: Lane-specific ordering. Overrides the system-level dependsOn for this action (e.g. Spanning runs last on offboard, after mailbox conversion and license removal).

requiresApproval.description: Hard gate — e.g. no device wipe / no account delete without written POC approval.

captureEvidence.description: Screenshot membership/app access and attach to the case before changing it. Common on offboard.

schedule.description: Defer this step instead of running it now (e.g. archive after 30-90 days).

guardrails.description: Destructive-action protections that vary by client and are catastrophic to get wrong.

config.description: System- and action-specific settings: license bundles, group lists, OU paths, mailbox thresholds, data-transfer targets, etc.

key.description: Selects the module/handler. Known: servicenow, active-directory, directory-sync, m365, entra, exchange, google-workspace, mimecast, adobe, zoom, slack, 1password, spanning, perimeter81, tableau, notion, printix, egnyte, avd, workstation, welcome-letter, first-day-call, hardware, data-transfer, archive, equipment-return, case-resolution.

secrets.description: One or more keys into the top-level secrets map (1Password needs login + security key).
